notes.title: Summer 2017 update
notes.content:
Hey kung fu fans just wanted to let you guys know the summer update just went public. Heres a list of some of the things included
2 new fighters
2 new stages
new music 
new moves for older fighters
updated animations for older fighters
and other misc tweaks and edits

Thanks for your support and I hope you enjoy this update and the others to come after. :)
***** 6 29 update*******
Added double wall jump for ninja
Changed White brows robe physics (May affect framerate a little)
Changed the collisions for characters (Beta)
Tweaked animations, optimized some stage elements and edited the music tracks to loop faster.
**** 7 4 update*****
New stage and song
new menu font
additional misc tweaks and edits
**** 7 5 update*****
Edited animations, moves and stage elements
Replaced the music on Sleeping Buddha stage

tags.balance_change: Changed White brows robe physics (May affect framerate a little)

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
This first patch address a few bugs and adds some gameplay tweaks :) ːsteamhappyː

Increased the general hit stun for all attacks

Expanded combo possibilities with basic attacks for all fighters

Changed the command for forward dash to - Y

Fixed the bug that caused the main menu music to stop playing upon leaving a game mode

Fixed bug where changing difficulty settings didnt save

White brow throw reaction animation has been corrected 

White brow overhead attack animation now plays correctly

Reduced general throw damage percentage

Fixed the clipping on the walls of the Shaolin School stage

Also adjusted some misc things.

Fixed Crouching Dash bug

Thanks for all of the support ann great feedback!!!!
Stick around there's alot more to come ːsteamhappyː
